findings.finding: This family files the same three forms as the Vermont sealing-by-conviction families, and differs from them by one question.
findings.consequence: Question 2 of 200-00130 is route-determined here: the packet marks 'I was not convicted for the offenses listed above' and refuses the whole conviction block beneath it -- the date of conviction, the probation questions and the restitution questions -- as a branch this route does not take.

findings.finding: The census records THREE routes for this family, and one of them files nothing at all.
findings.consequence: A composed process-guidance page carries that third route. A packet that only ever told the participant to file would be telling them to do work they may not need to do, and dropping the route rather than carrying it would have lost a third of what the family was built for.

findings.finding: Which non-conviction ending applies -- never charged, no probable cause, or dismissed -- is three different things that happened to a participant's own case.
findings.consequence: All three boxes stay the participant's, and the instructions say in terms which part the route decided and which part it did not.

findings.finding: Every caption in this map is read out of the pinned binary at build time rather than transcribed.
findings.consequence: The guard against a changed form is the exact SHA-256 source binding, which fails the family closed on any byte.

findings.finding: 600-00228 is a financial affidavit and the platform holds none of its figures.
findings.consequence: 110 blanks across the packet are required-before-filing and every one is named in participant-instructions.md.
